brief.headline: Duarte coolly slots a 74' penalty to swing the game wide open

facts.statement: Rafael Duarte scored from the penalty spot in the 74th minute.
The penalty had an xG of 0.74.
Kingsport’s chance of winning rose from about 28% to 75% after the goal.
The moment shifted the win probability by 47.6 percentage points.
Duarte finished the match so far with 1 goal, 10 shots and 2.124 total xG on the game.

brief.insight: Duarte chose a firm, unpressured left-footed penalty (shot speed 107.6 km/h) and placed it on target, prioritizing power and certainty over a risky panenka; that single decision converted a routine spot-kick into a decisive momentum swing that turned a roughly 28% chance of winning into a 75% probability for Kingsport.

telestration.caption: Duarte keeps his cool from the spot — Kingsport now 75% to win.

spec.question: What if Duarte had missed this 74th-minute penalty?
spec.hypothesis: The penalty had xG 0.7385 and the recorded goal changed the win probabilities from before (home 0.4644, draw 0.2605, away 0.2751) to after (home 0.0815, draw 0.1677, away 0.7508). If Duarte misses instead, I expect the simulations to show a substantially lower probability of an away (Kingsport) win than the recorded 0.7508 and corresponding increases in the draw and home (Riverside) win probabilities compared to the post-goal state, because a high-xG penalty not scored preserves the pre-penalty balance of the match and gives Riverside more chance to recover.

result.method: 40 paired futures from the instant of the shot (same random streams with and without the change)
